description.value: Ginza Sushi has been serving Japanese cuisine in West Kelowna's Governor Landings shopping centre since July 2008, next door to Value Village. The menu spans nigiri, sashimi, rolls, cone sushi, and combo boxes, with an emphasis on menu creations true to Japanese culinary tradition. Takeout and online ordering are available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Westbank corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully fetched and confirms a functioning sushi restaurant at #303–3021 Louie Drive, Westbank BC, matching OSM address tags. The site explicitly promotes takeout ordering ('Order for Takeout', 'See MENU & Order'), confirming that amenity. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Ginza Sushi' but the website consistently uses 'Ginza Sushi West Kelowna' as the business name.
OSM community field says 'Kelowna' but the business is located in West Kelowna (Westbank) — a separate municipality.
OSM has no phone number; phone 250-768-2028 sourced from website only, so contact_confirmed.phone is null.
No cycling amenities whatsoever are documented on the website or in OSM tags; all required criteria are unverified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate and active food stop with takeout, but no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are confirmed — the minimum required criteria for WWC listing cannot be verified from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to confirm at least bike parking/visibility and washroom access before including.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business is located in a commercial plaza (Governor Landings) next to Value Village. Plaza parking lots often have bike racks; a site visit could quickly resolve the bike parking and washroom questions.
